user.title: Set up Smart Heating
user.description: Only a name and time zone are needed to start. Smart Heating remains passive; review mappings and backend sections afterwards.

confirm.title: Confirm associations
confirm.description: Suggestions: {selected}. Ambiguous: {ambiguous}. Missing: {missing}. Nothing is stored without confirmation; Smart Heating remains passive.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Configure the weekly schedule. Overlaps are rejected.

error.confirmation_required: Review the suggestions and explicitly confirm them.

abort.already_configured: Smart Heating is already configured. Open the existing entry under Settings → Devices & services.

settings.title: Smart Heating settings
settings.description: Choose the operating mode and safety values. Edit the weekly schedule, window contacts, and room assignments in the clear Smart Heating sidebar; existing mappings are preserved.

data_description.summer_mode: Compatibility calculates summer status passively. HVAC off remains locked until explicitly supported by the installation.
data_description.operation_mode: Compatibility observes only. Full mode remains locked for productive heating control.
data_description.chimney_temperature: Target used by the passive chimney-sweep preview.
data_description.frost_temperature: Passive preview target for an open window or unknown safety state.
